page.notes: A stray mark stands before "nunquam" in the line "pro privilegio", and a vertical stroke appears before it; both are read as printer's marks and are not transcribed as letters. The words "ideo excommunicatos" are overprinted or smudged, so "excommunicatos" is doubtful. The reading "admisse" in the line "pro privilegio nunquam admisse" is a best reading of a worn word. The text of the first paragraph starts mid-sentence ("sa E. V."), as a fragment from the previous page.
